label: AI Insight UI — Smart City
info:
Smart City data backend for the restored Smart City views.

Exposes both:
  - Simulation-snapshot HTTP endpoints (/api/v1/streetlights, /traffic, /events,
    /city-weather and per-id /current and /history variants) consumed via
    api.ts's simGet helpers.
  - FAP §9 actions (smart-city.zones.list, smart-city.streetlights.list, etc.)
    routed by the dispatcher's link-to-smart-city for FAP-aligned consumers.

IMPORTANT: data is SYNTHESIZED at the orce layer (deterministic from time-of-day
and entity id). The simulation engine does not yet emit streetlight/traffic/
city-event/city-weather feeds — adding those is a follow-up for the simulation
team at services/simulation/. When real feeds land, the synthesizer here can be
replaced with `global.get('latest_streetlights')` etc.

Base entities (deterministic):
  3 zones: zone-center, zone-north, zone-south
  6 streetlights: 2 per zone
  Hour-of-day governs dimming (night → 100%, day → 0%, dusk/dawn → 50%) and
  traffic index (rush hour peaks), and selects events deterministically.
